card.name: Words right before "impact"
card.fires_on: Adjectives and articles after "have/has no/a" that sit just before the word "impact" or "effect", such as "noticeable", "considerable", "deep" and "severe". It also fires on the start of "impacts" when split into pieces.

modes.label: Modifier before impact
modes.description: A describing word or article after "have a" or "has no" where "impact" comes next.
modes.example: hardware-level encryption usually has no<< noticeable>> impact on performance.

modes.label: Start of impacts
modes.description: The first piece of the word "impacts" or a translated "efecto".

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "impact" or "effect" as the next word.
card.plain: It spots the slot where the word "impact" or "effect" is about to come, as in "had a big impact on".
